summary: An 80-ft Aermotor fire lookout on Joe Crihfield Rd. near Ripley, TN, built for the TN Division of Forestry around 1970; NRHP-listed in 2020 and listed as standing.

facts.design: 80-foot Aermotor tower with a parallel internal staircase

events.note: Constructed 1970 per TDF files as quoted in the NRHP MPS; Wikipedia says around 1970; NHLR says made sometime after 1964
Added to the National Register of Historic Places March 9, 2020, No. 100004684
Registered January 1, 2023 as US 1714, TN 47; nominated by Jason Johns

corrections.why: The NHLR Built field reads 'after 1964', not 1964. The NRHP MPS quotes TDF files dating the tower to 1970, which is the strongest source; Wikipedia's around 1970 agrees.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR says made sometime after 1964; Wikipedia says around 1970; the TDF files quoted in the NRHP MPS say constructed in 1970. Recorded as 1970 and the register's wording is noted in the story.

notes_for_editor: Brief's built year 1964 is a misreading of NHLR ('after 1964'); corrected to 1970 from TDF files. Brief's elevation (158.5 m) and 1 Jan 2023 registration match NHLR. Added height 80 ft = 24.4 m from NHLR. Staffing unknown; no staffing or fire history found. No access or visit data: NHLR calls the site an active TN Forestry location, which is not a public-access statement, so no access level is recorded. The NRHP listing date comes from Wikipedia (which cites AP) and the heritageindex/Aubrey pages; the NPGallery record for 100004684 was not readable. tnlandforms rows are laid out in columns; the standing status is read from the 'Ripley 521 Lauderdale 9-14 standing' row, which the same site's GPX file also shows. Used 2 web searches, within budget. No photos added; NHLR has photos but no image URLs were captured.
